title: [Shopify] Add cues for Skipped Records and API Errors on Activities page
summary: Two new cues on the Shopify Activities page display counts of skipped sync records and API errors, making background job issues visible without manually opening logs.
key_points: Added a Skipped Records cue that counts all Shpfy Skipped Record entries, turns amber when above zero and drills down to the Skipped Records page
Added an API Errors cue that counts log entries with errors, turns red when above zero and drills down to error-filtered Log Entries
Two new FlowFields (10, 11) on the Shpfy Cue table back the cues
Makes skipped records and errors from background Job Queue syncs visible, since the skipped-record notification needs GuiAllowed
Additive only and follows the existing cue pattern; no breaking changes
